{{Top|leg}}
The '''1/4/16/64 Plan''' was the standard mode of operations for the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and for the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] that succeeded it.

The plan divided the four subordinate [[Corps/Legends|corps]] of each [[Sector Army/Legends|sector army]] into smaller and smaller components, with one [[Corps/Legends|corps]] remaining intact as a mobile strategic reserve while the other three were split up. This allowed each sector army to coordinate one [[Corps/Legends|corps]]-level operation, four [[Brigade/Legends|brigade]]-level operations, sixteen [[Regiment/Legends|regimental]] missions, and sixty-four [[Battalion/Legends|battalion-level]] operations concurrently on different [[Planet/Legends|planets]] throughout the sector army's theatre of operations. Each corps was also paired with four [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] assault [[line]]s, containing two [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ships]] and two [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]], allowing great strategic mobility.

In practice, the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] typically kept one corps in each sector army intact, but divided the others into hundreds of fast-moving raiding [[Company/Legends|companies]], with only a dozen or so formations operating at the battalion or brigade level, most of them usually drawn from the reserve corps itself.

The Plan remained the same under the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], though the brigade was replaced by the [[Battle group/Legends|battlegroup]].
